job.job_description:
Role and Responsibilities




Frontend:

Build responsive, accessible, and performant user interfaces using React.js and Tailwind CSS.
Develop modular, reusable component libraries with clean, well-documented code.
Implement AI-driven UI features smart search, contextual recommendations, conversational interfaces, and real-time insights surfaces.
Manage frontend state efficiently using Redux, Zustand, or Context API.
Integrate REST and GraphQL APIs; ensure cross-browser compatibility and Core Web Vital benchmarks.



Backend:

Design and build scalable RESTful APIs using Node.js / Express.js and Python / Django.
Architect backend services with an AI-first approach integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), building retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, and creating intelligent automation workflows.
Implement secure authentication and authorisation systems (JWT, OAuth 2.0, RBAC).
Optimise server performance; manage background jobs, message queues, and event-driven architectures.
Expose and consume webhooks and third-party integrations across Zoho, payment gateways, and enterprise platforms.



AI Engineering:

Champion an AI-first development philosophy proactively identifying features, workflows, or user pain-points that can be enhanced through AI/ML.
Integrate and fine-tune LLM-based capabilities such as text generation, summarisation, classification, and semantic search within SaaS products.
Build and maintain AI pipelines including prompt engineering, embedding workflows, vector database integration (Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector), and output validation layers.
Leverage AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) to accelerate development without compromising code quality or security.
Collaborate with product and business teams to translate use cases into intelligent, data-driven features.
Stay current with the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and advocate for adoption of proven, production-ready AI capabilities.



Databases:

Work with MySQL / PostgreSQL for relational data design, complex queries, and migrations.
Design and implement MongoDB (NoSQL) schemas for document-centric workloads.
Manage vector stores and embeddings for semantic search and AI memory layers.
Write optimised SQL, stored procedures, and manage indexing strategies for performance at scale.



Collaboration & Engineering Practices:

Work closely with UI/UX designers, product managers, QA engineers, and Zoho implementation consultants.
Actively participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies sprint planning, standups, retrospectives.
Conduct and receive structured code reviews; enforce engineering standards and documentation practices.
Participate in CI/CD pipeline management; contribute to test coverage using Jest, Mocha, or PyTest.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues across the full stack with a structured, root-cause-driven approach.
